Alfredo sauce is the easiest thing in the world.

It has 4 ingredients and takes 15 minutes.

Get a small sauce pan. Put in 1/4 cup of butter and set it to medium heat. Once the butter is melted, put in 1/2 cup of heavy whipping cream and stir continuously until it's thoroughly mixed. Get the sauce back to boiling then add 3/4 of freshly grated parmesan. Stir continuously until it's mixed in. Add 1/8 teaspoon salt and pepper and add a couple cloves of crushed garlic. Stir for a minute and serve. You can get parsley and pick off the leaves to drop them in if you want.

Now I offer this one warning - do not make any substitutions. No margarine, no pre-grated parmesan, etc.
